signatures.caption_assembly: Character-by-character reveal using Framer Motion stagger (`staggerChildren: 0.02`). Characters fade from opacity 0 to 1 strictly (no Y-axis translation to maintain cinematic solidity).
signatures.waveform: Subtle vertical scaling of 3-5 vertical bars to simulate TTS playback. Use framer-motion with `repeat: Infinity` and `repeatType: mirror`.
signatures.landmark_overlay: SVG skeleton drawing paths between joints. Circular nodes pulse softly with `#6EE7F2` glow.
signatures.gloss_reordering: Smooth horizontal layout animation using Framer Motion's `layoutId` or `layout` prop on flex chips as English translates into ISL sequence.

accessibility.prefers_reduced_motion: All animations MUST be conditionally disabled using Framer Motion's `useReducedMotion()`. Swap complex staggers for simple opacity fades.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against `#0B0B0D` or image overlays meets 4.5:1 WCAG AA. Use gradients behind text overlaying images.
accessibility.keyboard_nav: Visible focus rings on all interactive elements: `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#6EE7F2] focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-[#0B0B0D] focus:outline-none`.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use `framer-motion` for all core UI animations (caption assembly, gloss reordering). Check for reduced motion globally.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for the main app shell, leveraging flexbox and CSS Grid. Do not rely heavily on pre-built generic UI component libraries if they clash with the custom aesthetic.
For the animated landmark overlay, create a custom SVG layer with pulsing `<circle>` and `<line>` elements to simulate MediaPipe hand tracking output.
The application is desktop-first, tailored for Chrome/Edge. Ensure hover states and keyboard navigation are highly polished.
Ensure backgrounds never use pure transparent when text sits on top of moving content. Use `#0B0B0D`/60 with backdrop-blur.
Ensure all interactive components and key states have descriptive `data-testid` attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make the UI look like a high-end, cinematic editorial app, not a standard SaaS template.
Do NOT apply universal transitions like `transition: all`. Specify transition properties (e.g., `transition-colors`, `transition-transform`) to prevent breaking framer-motion.
Generous Spacing Philosophy: Use 2-3x more spacing than feels normal. `p-8` to `p-12` inside major panels.
No emojis anywhere in the UI. Use sleek Lucide icons.
Ensure color contrast strictly meets WCAG AA criteria.
Include `data-testid` on all buttons, inputs, links, and important text fields.
